Metadata.title: Safolio — Portfolio analysis and reporting
Metadata.description: Safolio is an independent portfolio analysis and reporting app. It brings your stocks, crypto, ETFs and gold into one read-only view with performance reports and risk analysis. Safolio never executes trades or holds funds.

Hero.sub: Safolio is an independent portfolio analysis and reporting app. It brings all your holdings — stocks, crypto, ETFs, gold — into one clear view, with performance reports and advanced risk analysis to help you make informed decisions.
Hero.ctaNote: Be among the first to try. No spam, ever.
Hero.successMessage: You're on the list — we'll be in touch.
Hero.trustA: Independent — not tied to any bank or broker

Features.sub: Safolio is a portfolio analysis and reporting tool. See the bigger picture, understand your risks and review your strategy. Any buying or selling stays with your own bank or broker.
Features.f1_b: Not tied to any bank or broker. Every calculation and analysis is built for your benefit and trust.
Features.f2_b: From stocks to crypto, funds to gold, track and analyse all your holdings in one place.
Features.f3_b: Learn from your past and plan your future. Record the transactions you made elsewhere, together with the reasoning behind them.
Features.f4_b: No surprises. Clear risk metrics show your concentration, volatility and currency exposure at a glance.
Features.f5_b: Learn, share and grow together. A community of investors reviewing their own portfolios — no gurus, no signals.

Preview.h: A dashboard that shows what matters first.
Preview.sub: Designed around the questions investors actually ask: How am I doing? Where is my risk? What changed?

How.h: Set up in minutes. Use it for years.
How.s1_b: Add positions manually, via CSV, or through a read-only account connection. Your data, your control.
How.s2_b: Safolio normalises across asset classes and currencies, then surfaces risk you couldn't see before.
How.s3_b: Run what-if scenarios, journal your reasoning, and review your strategy with the data in front of you. You decide, and act at your own bank or broker.

Personas.h: Wherever you are on your investment journey.
Personas.p1: New investors taking their very first steps into the world of investing
Personas.p2: Experienced investors looking for deeper analysis and clearer reporting
Personas.p3: Those tracking both crypto and traditional assets together
Personas.p4: Investment communities that love to share knowledge
Personas.p5: Savers who want a clear, reliable view of how their investments are doing
Personas.p6: Financial professionals seeking advanced analysis and clarity
Personas.p7: Thought leaders and influencers shaping the future of finance

ReadOnly.sub: Safolio is an analysis and reporting tool, not a trading platform. It only reads your portfolio data to show you reports and insights.
ReadOnly.i1_b: Safolio does not buy, sell or place orders. Every transaction happens at your own bank, broker or exchange.
ReadOnly.i2_b: Safolio does not hold, receive or move money or crypto. Your assets stay where they are.
ReadOnly.i3_b: Connected accounts are accessed read-only, only to fetch holdings and prices for analysis. Safolio cannot change anything in them.
ReadOnly.i4_b: Reports and risk scores are for information only. Decisions stay with you.

Manifesto.p1: We believe investing is a right for everyone, no matter the size of their savings.
Manifesto.p2: Too many investors get lost in scattered platforms and overwhelming information. As investors ourselves, we built Safolio — a trustworthy, independent analysis platform that helps you make your own decisions, backed by unbiased reporting and advanced risk insights.
Manifesto.p3: As you plan for your future, you're no longer alone. Safolio is with you 24/7, giving you a clear view of your portfolio so you can make informed choices.

CTA.sub: One read-only view of everything you own, with the reports and risk analysis to understand it.

Footer.disclaimer: Safolio is a portfolio analysis and reporting tool. It does not execute trades, hold client funds or provide investment advice.

CookieBanner.message: We use cookies for analytics. Read more in our cookie policy.
